stages.name: GOAL
stages.detail: High-level objective specification from user or upstream pipeline

stages.name: PLAN
stages.detail: Hierarchical decomposition into atomic shell, browser, and GUI commands

stages.name: ACT
stages.detail: Direct execution via OS sandbox: PTY bash, Chromium DevTools, virtual mouse/keys

stages.name: OBSERVE
stages.detail: Capture screenshot, DOM tree, stdout/stderr, process exit code

stages.name: ADAPT
stages.detail: Self-correcting error diagnostics; replan upon unexpected output

stages.name: COMPLETE
stages.detail: Deterministic verification of terminal goal state
